# openwrt_firewall_zone (Resource)

A firewall zone (`config zone`).

Manages a `zone` section in `/etc/config/firewall`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwrt_firewall_zone" "iot" {
  section = "zone_iot"
  name    = "iot"
  network = ["iot"]
  input   = "REJECT"
  output  = "ACCEPT"
  forward = "REJECT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, referenced by forwardings and rules. (UCI option `name`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `auto_helper` (Boolean) Automatically assign conntrack helpers. (UCI option `auto_helper`.)
- `conntrack` (Boolean) Force connection tracking. (UCI option `conntrack`.)
- `device` (List of String) Raw devices in the zone. (UCI option `device`.)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the zone. (UCI option `enabled`.)
- `extra_dest` (String) Extra match arguments for destination rules. (UCI option `extra_dest`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_src` (String) Extra match arguments for source rules. (UCI option `extra_src`.)
- `family` (String) Address family. (UCI option `family`.) One of: `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `any`.
- `forward` (String) Forward policy. (UCI option `forward`.) One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `helper` (List of String) Conntrack helpers. (UCI option `helper`.)
- `input` (String) Input policy. (UCI option `input`.) One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `log` (Number) Log rejected/dropped traffic (bitmask on fw4). (UCI option `log`.)
- `log_limit` (String) Log rate limit, e.g. `10/minute`. (UCI option `log_limit`.)
- `masq` (Boolean) Enable IPv4 masquerading. (UCI option `masq`.)
- `masq6` (Boolean) Enable IPv6 masquerading. (UCI option `masq6`.)
- `masq_dest` (List of String) Limit masquerading to these destination subnets. (UCI option `masq_dest`.)
- `masq_src` (List of String) Limit masquerading to these source subnets. (UCI option `masq_src`.)
- `mtu_fix` (Boolean) Enable MSS clamping. (UCI option `mtu_fix`.)
- `network` (List of String) Logical interfaces in the zone. (UCI option `network`.)
- `output` (String) Output policy. (UCI option `output`.) One of: `ACCEPT`, `REJECT`, `DROP`.
- `subnet` (List of String) Subnets in the zone. (UCI option `subnet`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Anonymous stock zones are addressed by type and index.
tofu import openwrt_firewall_zone.lan @zone[0]
```
